Check an API spec and write its diagnostics to stderr, writing no IR anywhere.
validate is compile's pipeline with the document dropped instead of marshalled,
for a gate that wants the diagnostics and the exit code and would throw the
document away.

This build compiles openapi@3.0, openapi@3.1, openapi@3.2.

The diagnostics and the exit code are compile's: 0 when nothing reaches
--fail-on, 1 when something does or the spec lowered to no document at all, 2
for a misuse, an I/O error, a compiler or pass that broke its contract, or a
run a signal stopped.

--skip-validate and --disable-pass validate are interchangeable. Both name the
IR pass called validate, not this command: they drop that pass's diagnostics and
keep the compiler's.

--verify is compile's, and holds the same stages to the same invariants.

--opt is compile's, and takes the same settings: a spec that needs one to
compile needs it here too, or what is checked is not what would be built.

--cache-dir is compile's, and shares its entries: a run of either answers the
other.

--triage, --diag-format, --show and --diag-limit are compile's, and write the
same findings the same way.

SIGINT, SIGTERM or SIGHUP stops the run, unless it comes once the compile is
over: the diagnostics are then written whole, and the run exits as though it
had not come. Another while the run is stopping changes nothing.

Usage:
  morphic validate <spec-file> [flags]

Examples:
  # diagnostics and exit code only
  morphic validate openapi.yaml

  # a stricter gate: exit 1 on a warning too
  morphic validate openapi.yaml --fail-on warning

Flags:
      --cache-dir string             keep compiled documents in this directory, and reuse one while nothing it depends on has changed
      --diag-format format           write the findings to stderr as text, for a person, or as one JSON report, for a program (default text)
      --diag-limit count             in text, write this many findings of one code and severity, and count the rest; 0 writes every one (default 3)
      --disable-pass name            turn off the IR pass with this name (repeatable)
      --fail-on threshold            exit 1 on a finding rated at or above this severity that no --triage rule accepted: error, warning or info; none exits 1 only when the spec lowered to no document (default error)
  -h, --help[=true|false]            help for validate
      --opt key=value                set one key=value option on the compiler the spec selects (repeatable)
      --show severity                in text, write each finding at or above this severity, error, warning or info, and count the rest (default info)
      --skip-validate[=true|false]   alias for --disable-pass validate
      --triage string                rate or accept findings by code and place, as the rules this JSON file lists say
      --verify[=true|false]          check the IR each stage returns against the IR's invariants, and that no pass changes its input; for developing a stage, and slow
